facts.fact: DatacenterDynamics reports Galaxy Backbone's National Shared Services Center in Abuja is an Uptime-certified Tier III facility, run for seven to eight years for the public sector by Galaxy Backbone, which serves public and private users; no certification date is given, so the article date 2022-09-07 is used.

systems.system: Galaxy Backbone Kano Data Recovery and Business Continuity center

note: Kano centre only construction completed and ready to launch, so not a fact; NSSC Abuja Tier III fact depends on Galaxy Backbone counting as for hire (government shared services, public and private use).
